head: Roku app for iPhone: free movies and live TV with no account
dek: Roku has put out a new app, Roku App (Official), for watching free movies, shows and more than 500 live TV channels on iPhone and iPad without an account, subscription or credit card. It came out on 10 November and was #73 among free Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: The app has a live TV guide with news, weather, sports, sitcoms and movies, plus Roku Originals. With a Roku account you can subscribe to and manage more than 70 paid services in the app, keep a Save List and pick up where you left off on other devices. Roku's older app is now listed separately as Roku Remote (Official) and still works as a remote for Roku players and TVs.
where: iPhone and iPad, free on the US App Store (iOS 17 or later)
means: If you want free TV on your phone, you can now open Roku's app and start watching without signing up or owning a Roku device.
todo: Search for Roku App (Official) by ROKU INC in the App Store. Keep Roku Remote (Official) if you use your phone to control a Roku TV.
thumb_words: ROKU APP: FREE TV, NO ACCOUNT
